value.rationale: The inverse problem asks how much of a natural numerical monoid invariant must be retained to recover the biclique. The parity of the first informative rank is structural: rank three can never resolve the rank-two ambiguity, whereas rank four always does. An infinite family realizes the obstruction; the result gives a usable uniform cutoff independent of graph size, not just another forward census.
